name: glycerin + petrolatum + phenylephrine hydrochloride (+/-)- + pramoxine
uses: Helps relieve the pain, itching, and burning associated with hemorrhoids and other anorectal disorders Temporarily protects the inflamed, irritated anorectal surface to help make bowel movements less painful from irritation and abrasion during bowel movement. Temporarily shrinks hemorrhoidal tissue.
otcwarn: For external use only (skin of the perianal area and anal canal). Ask a doctor before use if you have heart disease high blood pressure thyroid disease diabetes difficulty in urination due to enlargement of the prostate gland presently taking a prescription drug for high blood pressure or depression When using this product avoid contact with eyes do not exceed recommended dosage unless directed by a doctor do not put this product into the rectum by using fingers or any mechanical device or applicator
